description: React component definitions for skeleton loading UI elements, including Skeleton, SkeletonAvatar, SkeletonText, SkeletonButton, SkeletonContainer, and SelectSkeletonLoader.

classes.name: SkeletonContainer
classes.description: A container component that can render as different HTML elements and applies animation classes.

methods.name: Skeleton
methods.description: A flexible skeleton loader component that can render as different HTML elements and handle loading states with optional translation wait.

methods.name: SkeletonAvatar
methods.description: A skeleton placeholder for avatar images, styled as a rounded full div.

methods.name: SkeletonText
methods.description: A skeleton placeholder for text, with optional invisibility and custom styles.

methods.name: SelectSkeletonLoader
methods.description: A skeleton loader for select list items, showing placeholder text and icons.
